desc: While a fire burns in this brazier, you can use an action to speak the brazier's command word and summon a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.8SMQl75HLjhuSeau]{Fire Elemental}, as if you had cast the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells.Item.1LkZvINag7KqBmDR]{Conjure Elemental} spell. The brazier can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
name: brazier of commanding fire elementals
